place_fields.summary: A public animal park in Belagavi Cantonment with birds, deer and other animals; local sources describe it as a family-oriented leisure spot.

planning_attributes.description: Military Animal Park is listed as a zoo/tourist attraction on E W Fernandes Road in Hirekodi, Camp, Belagavi.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: E W Fernandes Road, Hirekodi, Camp, Belagavi; one local directory places it about 0.53 km from Belagavi railway station.

place_fields.summary: Ghataprabha Bird Sanctuary is a 29.78 km² protected area around the Ghataprabha River, including more than 22 islands and habitat for over 225 bird species.
place_fields.best_time: November to March, when migratory birds are present.

planning_attributes.description: The sanctuary is known for migratory Demoiselle Cranes and European White Storks, along with resident birdlife and other fauna.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The protected area was notified in 1974. Sources differ on the Dhupadal reservoir construction date: one reports 1883, another 1884.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The Government of India's tourism compendium lists Belgaum airport about 69 km away, Ghataprabha railway station 2 km away, and Gokak 10 km by road.
planning_attributes.notes: Karnataka Tourism places the sanctuary about 70 km from Belagavi and identifies it as a bird-watching and wildlife destination.
